description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named SecurityController that handles administrator security-related web requests, specifically for displaying user permissions and groups in the admin interface.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that manages security-related admin pages, including displaying permissions and user groups.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the permissions page, sets up the menu, and returns the view name 'admin-user-permissions'.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display user groups, retrieves the list of groups of type ADMIN from the service, adds it to the model, and returns the view 'admin-user-groups'.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares and adds menu-related attributes to the model for rendering the navigation menu.
